podcast.body: Released in 1995 on Cargo Music, this was Blink-182's most recent album when they played the Warped Tour in 1996. They performed songs like "Wasting Time" from this record. "Their 1995 album, the most recent they'd done, was called Cheshire Cat."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Debut Studio Album
podcast.body: Released on February 17, 1995, by Cargo Records. This album was recorded over six intense days, with the band often working 12-hour shifts to produce 16 tracks, many recorded live, which contributed to its "frantic feel." Initially available only on cassette, it transitioned to CD after fans began bootlegging CD burns, selling around 3,000 copies, and featured singles like "M&Ms" and "Wasting Time." "Released on February 17, 1995, there's Blink 182, who remember, still known as Blink at the time, with M&Ms, a song from their album called Cheshire Cat."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Rise and Fall and Rise of Blink 182 Part 1

podcast.title: Indie Album
podcast.body: This indie album was being promoted by Blink-182 during the 1996 Warped Tour. The band represented a shift towards a maximum level of accessibility for punk music. "The 96 Tour featured this trio from San Diego, who was plugging an indie album called Cheshire Cat."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
